name: recipe-clipper
description: Save the recipe on the current page as a Cooklang .cook file.

scripts.build:safari: npm run reader:js && wxt build -b safari --mv3
scripts.build:safari-app: npm run build:safari && xcodebuild -project "safari/Cooklang Recipe Clipper.xcodeproj" -scheme "Cooklang Recipe Clipper" -configuration Release -derivedDataPath safari/build build
